name: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary is a cloud-based service that provides an end-to-end image and video management solution, including uploads, storage, manipulations, optimizations, and delivery.

events.d: Delete images or videos by Asset ID, Public ID, prefix, or all; optionally keep originals, invalidate CDN cache, or apply transformations.
List or search the resources in your Cloudinary account, or get a single resource by its Public ID or Asset ID.
Retrieve product environment configuration; optionally pass settings to filter results.
List root folders in your Cloudinary account. Limit results using Max Results.
Retrieve all or a specific adaptive streaming profile; optionally limit results using max_results.
Retrieve transformations or a specific named transformation, with optional filters and max results.
List all Cloudinary triggers, optionally filtered by event type.
List upload mappings or mappings in a chosen folder, with optional max results.
List upload presets or fetch a specific preset by name; supports a max results limit.
Get a report showing your account’s storage, bandwidth, request and resource counts, and add‑on usage for a specific date (within the last 3 months).
Create a URL for a resource with the specified transformations (size, crop, gravity, quality, effects, named transformations, and format).
Upload an image, video, or raw file to Cloudinary and set options like public ID, folder, tags, format, transformations, access mode, and notification URL.
List subfolders of a specified parent folder. Set folder path and optional max results (up to 2000).
